headline: Names a Santa Barbara, California Postal Service building after Navy SEAL Master Chief Louis J. Langlais.
what_it_does: This law renames a United States Postal Service facility at 1221 State Street in Santa Barbara, California. The building will be officially called the Special Warfare Operator Master Chief Petty Officer (SEAL) Louis 'Lou' J. Langlais Post Office Building. It does not change how the post office operates or what services it offers.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on December 16, 2016.
